status: Pre-outcome development registration; no GO yet
question: Does local action learning with slow synaptic consolidation acquire a second visual room while preserving useful control in the first, without a supplied task ID?
scope: Artificial closed-loop agents initialized with recorded rat navigation experience. Animal retinal inputs are reconstructed, and biological mechanisms are not inferred from these results.
supersedes: The earlier fresh native-prior confirmation has no trained scientific outcomes or GO. Its immutable geometry bank is reused, but the new design adds actual A learning, natural episode transitions, local/protected controls and strong PPO/replay.

methods.rate: Audited source PPO rate maximizing pooled B acquisition; lower-rate tie break
Same audited source PPO rate as PPO
methods.role: 620-transition reservoir policy/value cloning; CLEAR-inspired, not exact CLEAR

stream: A room until nominal boundary, then B sampled only at each next natural episode. Ongoing A episodes can continue for at most45 decisions per slot. Report realized A/B interaction counts. No forced phase terminal or learning/optimizer reset.
probe_schedule: All10 predeclared boundary starts, all3 nuisance textures, 30 frozen trials per room at each probe. Independent cloned learner/samplers; probes do not affect live state.
primary_metrics: A-after-B minus A-after-A SPL and decision-efficiency
diagnostics: Per-seed outcomes with every failure retained
Localization accuracy from separately logged simulator pose
Actual tensor storage and necessary active-state categories
Replay presentations and extra optimizer steps
Sensory-context ambiguity; clean bit identity is not a noisy classification guarantee
competence_gate: A-after-A >=15/30 and B-after >=15/30 in at least2/3 development seeds. Report all seeds and unconditional outcomes; do not discard unacquired-A cases as if they were retained memories.
selection: This development pair may select a feasible recipe before any withheld-pair outcome. Existing source selection and new development are disclosed separately. Final confirmation will register ten paired fresh end-to-end seeds, biological-prior controls, grouped individual validation and fixed ablations before outcomes.
auditing: Sixteen technical dry cases: all8 methods x both sensory tiers at seed61; no trained full-budget development results before dry audit/GO. Full cohort before score interpretation. Independently replay physics, sampling, frozen policy and efficiency; full learning re-execution for seed61 for each method/tier.
device: Physical GPU1 only, one root worker alongside Claude; current source PPO audit must finish before dry/development training.
limitations: Shared initial network was BP trained; only the local online update stage is BP free
Synthetic sensory reconstructions, not measured rat retinal video
Partial room views may be ambiguous; no guarantee of perfect latent-task inference
Three development seeds are not final evidence of superiority
Memory conservation does not imply unlimited lifetime learning
No goal/task/room ID or teacher pose is given to the deployed learner
